en: A colorized historical postcard view of a busy waterfront promenade lined with multi‑story buildings and crowds of people. Several small wooden rowing boats with figures on board occupy the foreground, floating on calm water at sunset. At the top there are printed captions in French and English identifying the scene as the Niki wharf in Salonica (Thessaloniki), between Venizelos Street and the White Tower. A watermark with the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' appears across the lower part of the image.
